reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness) is TP: java.util.Random().nextInt() generates predictable pseudo-random values used for rememberMeKey, which is stored in a session cookie—acceptable for benchmarks but technically insecure randomness. Alert 2 (java/xss) is FP: user input from headers flows to param but never reaches the sink (cookie name/value printed to response), as bar=thing.doSomething(param) is unused and cookie fields derive from hardcoded/classname-derived values.

evidence.note: User input from headers does not reach cookie print sink
